Bhala nokuthi isimangalo sikaSeojin silungile yini.

y-m-28-14.title: Ukwenza inkinga enezixazululo ezimbili kodwa eyodwa kuphela iyimpendulo
y-m-28-14.topic: Ukusebenzisa izibalo ze-quadratic nokuthi izixazululo zilungile yini
y-m-28-14.goal: Qonda ukuthi kumele uhlole ukuthi izixazululo zesibalo se-quadratic zihambisana nezimo zesimo senkinga (ubude buyiphozithivu), bese wenza inkinga ehambisana nezimo wena bese uhlola izixazululo zayo.
y-m-28-14.material: Ububanzi bensimu yemifino eyisikwele esinde bungu-x m, futhi ubude bayo bude ngo-3 m kunobubanzi. Indawo ingu-40 m². (m² ifundwa 'square meters'.) Isibalo ngu-x(x+3) = 40, okungukuthi, x² + 3x − 40 = 0, futhi njengoba (x+8)(x−5)=0, izixazululo ngu-x=5 no-x=−8.

y-m-28-14.thinking.2: Hlukanisa izimo zokulahla isixazululo nezimo zokusebenzisa zombili

y-m-28-14.s.s1.hint.1: Uma uthatha u-x=−8 njengobubanzi, bala ukuthi ubude u-x+3 buyini.
y-m-28-14.s.s1.r.a: Womabili amanani anelisa isibalo, kodwa kumele uhlole nesimo senkinga sokuthi x imele ubude.
y-m-28-14.s.s1.o.b: U-x=−8 unenani eliphelele elikhulu, ngakho sebenzisa kuphela omkhulu, u-x=−8, njengempendulo
y-m-28-14.s.s1.r.b: Ubude obungu-negethivu abukho esimweni senkinga. Impendulo akuyona leyo enosayizi omkhulu.

y-m-28-14.s.s1.o.d: Sebenzisa u-x=5 kuphela. U-x=−8 awuhambisani ngoba ubude buzoba ngu-negethivu
y-m-28-14.s.s1.r.d: Lesi sinqumo esihlola izixazululo zesibalo nezimo zenkinga ngokwehlukana.

y-m-28-14.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala inkinga owenzile njengo-x²+kx−A=0 bese uhlola ukuthi r iyisixazululo.

y-m-28-01.title: Iphosa kuphi isixazululo sikaJiho: 6÷(√5−√2)
y-m-28-01.topic: Ukuhlola isixazululo sengxenyana enesihlukanisi esinesisekelo, nokuhlola ngokulinganisela
y-m-28-01.goal: Thola futhi ulungise umugqa ongalungile esixazululweni esenza ingxenyana enesihlukanisi esinesisekelo ibe nesihlukanisi esingenaso isisekelo, bese ubhala indlela yokuhlola umphumela ngenani elilinganiselwe.
y-m-28-01.material:
Inkinga: Bhala u-6/(√5−√2) ngendlela engenaso isisekelo esihlukanisini. (√ ifundwa 'root'. √5 ngu-'root five' futhi √2 ngu-'root two'. Ungasebenzisa ukulinganisela √5≈2.236 no-√2≈1.414.)
UJiho uyixazulule njengoba kubonisiwe ngezansi. Izinombolo zemigqa yesixazululo zibonisiwe esikrinini kusukela ku-1.
y-m-28-01.thinking.1: Khetha indlela yokuhlola umphumela ngaphandle kokuxazulula futhi kusukela ekuqaleni
y-m-28-01.prereq.0: Ukunweba umkhiqizo wezisho ezimbili ezinezisekelo (ebangeni lamafomula okuphindaphinda)
y-m-28-01.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola, umugqa owodwa ngesikhathi, ukuthi umugqa ngamunye uvele kanjani kumugqa ongaphambi kwawo ngqo.
y-m-28-01.s.s1.hint.1: Emugqeni lapho isihlukanisi sibalwa, qhathanisa uphawu phakathi kwezinkathi ezimbili nesisho ngaphambi kokuphindaphinda, inkathi eyodwa ngesikhathi.
y-m-28-01.s.s1.line.0: Phindaphinda inombolo engaphezulu nesihlukanisi ngenombolo efanayo (√5+√2). Njengoba siphindaphinda ngenombolo efanayo, inani alishintshi.
y-m-28-01.s.s1.line.4: Asikho isisekelo esihlukanisini, ngakho isixazululo siqediwe.
y-m-28-01.s.s1.explain: Emugqeni 3, (√5−√2)(√5+√2) inezinkathi eziphakathi ezikhanselana, ngakho iba ngu-(√5)²−(√2)²=5−2=3. Akungu-5+2=7. Ngakho umphumela emugqeni 4 nawo awulungile, futhi inani elilungile ngu-6(√5+√2)/3=2(√5+√2).
y-m-28-01.s.s2.prompt: Ufuna ukuhlola ukuthi umphumela kaJiho ulungile yini ngaphandle kokuxazulula futhi kusukela ekuqaleni. Iyiphi indlela engabamba ngempela umphumela ongalungile?
y-m-28-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ekhethweni ngalunye, liqhathanise nomphumela kaJiho ukubona ukuthi lingakutshela ngempela ukuthi umphumela wakhe ongalungile awulungile.
y-m-28-01.s.s2.hint.1: Isisho sokuqala nesisho sesiphetho kumele kube yinombolo efanayo. Khona, uma ufaka amanani alinganiselwe afanayo kuzo zombili, yini okufanele ilingane?
y-m-28-01.s.s2.o.a: Faka √5≈2.236 no-√2≈1.414 kuzo zombili izisho bese uziqhathanisa
y-m-28-01.s.s2.r.a: Lolu hlolo lusebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi izisho ezimbili kumele zibe nenani elifanayo. Uma amanani ehluka kakhulu, kunento engalungile ndawo thize.
y-m-28-01.s.s2.o.b: Bheka ukuthi u-√5 no-√2 busele yini esibalweni esiphumile
y-m-28-01.s.s2.r.b: Ukuhlola okubheka kuphela isimo kuvumela isixazululo esiphutha ukuthi sidlule. Umphumela ophutha kaJiho nawo uqukethe u-√5 no-√2.
y-m-28-01.s.s2.o.c: Bala isixazululo esifanayo futhi ngokulandelana okufanayo ubone ukuthi uthola impendulo efanayo yini
y-m-28-01.s.s2.r.c: Uma uphinda ngomcabango ofanayo, iphutha elifanayo lingaphindwa.
y-m-28-01.s.s2.o.d: Isihlukanisi saba yinombolo ephelele 7, ngakho ifomu lilungile futhi uyaqhubeka
y-m-28-01.s.s2.r.d: Isihlukanisi esiyinombolo ephelele sikhombisa kuphela ukuthi ifomu lilungile, hhayi ukuthi inani lilungile.
y-m-28-01.s.s2.explain: Isibalo sokuqala singu-6÷(2.236−1.414)≈7.30, futhi umphumela kaJiho ungu-6×3.650÷7≈3.13, okuhluke kakhulu. Ukufaka amanani alinganiselwe kuhlunga ngokushesha amaphutha amakhulu. Kodwa, amanani alinganiselwe afanayo akufakazeli ukuthi isixazululo silungile.
